package.json.summary: The private root npm package defines the Frontend and Backend workspaces and requires Node.js 22.12.0 or newer. Its commands coordinate workspace development, verification, database operations, and Graphify/Obsidian exports; run these commands from the repository root.

Frontend/package.json.summary: The private ECMAScript-module frontend package declares React, maps, animation, icons, styling, and Vite tooling. Building first generates third-party notices through npm’s prebuild lifecycle hook, then checks TypeScript and bundles browser assets.

Backend/package.json.summary: The private ECMAScript-module API package declares Express, PostgreSQL access, request rate limiting, and Zod validation. Development and database scripts load the local .env file; build emits JavaScript and start runs the compiled server.

Frontend/tsconfig.json.summary: This solution-style TypeScript configuration contains no source files directly. Its references make build mode check the browser application and Node-based Vite configuration as separate projects.

Frontend/tsconfig.app.json.summary: This configuration checks browser source under src using ES2023 and DOM declarations, React’s automatic JSX transform, and bundler-style resolution. It emits no JavaScript because Vite owns the bundle, while unused-symbol and restricted-syntax checks catch mistakes.

Frontend/tsconfig.node.json.summary: This configuration checks vite.config.ts with Node types and NodeNext module semantics. It emits no JavaScript and keeps build metadata separate from the browser project.

Backend/tsconfig.json.summary: The API compiler checks src with strict typing, NodeNext modules, and extra indexed-access safety. It emits ES2022 JavaScript from src into dist; tests and administrative scripts are outside this base include list.

Backend/tsconfig.test.json.summary: This configuration extends the API compiler settings to include src, test, and scripts. It changes rootDir to the Backend directory and disables output so the backend typecheck command also checks code outside production src.

Frontend/.oxlintrc.json.summary: This Oxlint configuration enables React, TypeScript, and Oxc plugin rules. Hook-rule violations are errors; non-component exports receive a warning while constant exports are allowed.

Frontend/vite.config.ts.summary: Vite combines React and Tailwind plugins, serves on port 5173 with a strict port requirement, and proxies /api to API_PROXY_TARGET or the local API default. Its explicit filesystem allow list and private-file deny patterns keep the frontend development server from serving sibling backend and database files.

Frontend/test/api.test.ts.summary: Node-based tests replace fetch to verify API mutation errors, same-origin cookies, successful response preservation, empty logout responses, non-JSON failures, and account-bound autosave headers. Cleanup restores fetch and clears notifications after each test; these are client-helper tests rather than real backend requests.

Frontend/test/toast.test.ts.summary: Node tests verify duplicate suppression, the four-notification bound, error kinds, dismissal, subscriber notifications, and unsubscription. Cleanup clears the shared toast store after each test.

Frontend/test/vite-security.test.ts.summary: This test starts a real Vite development server on an ephemeral loopback port and creates a harmless database-directory probe. It verifies the frontend entry point is served while the probe and Backend/src/db.ts receive HTTP 403, then closes the server and deletes the probe.

scripts/generate-third-party-notices.mjs.summary: This frontend prebuild script reads installed runtime-package metadata and recursively collects license, COPYING, and NOTICE files. It writes Frontend/public/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.txt, deduplicates by package name/version, and fails if a package or its notice file cannot be found; it is a distribution helper, not an application request handler.

scripts/export-obsidian.mjs.summary: Publishes the consolidated Obsidian knowledge base into the requested folder. It detects the actual vault root and delegates grouping, link migration, edit preservation, backup, and obsolete-note archival to consolidateVault. It no longer runs Graphify’s granular Obsidian export into the active vault.

scripts/obsidian-guides.mjs.summary: Publishes maintained Markdown guides and generated reference notes with a reading map. Source citations resolve to the checkout, while a SHA-256 manifest preserves locally edited canonical files. It supports the consolidated export only.

scripts/obsidian-note-context.mjs.summary: Parses current TypeScript declarations for the consolidated documentation. It matches a named declaration near its indexed line and extracts field contracts, function inputs, array shape and source spans. This module handles syntax details only; it does not publish granular notes or load explanation maps.

scripts/obsidian-consolidate.mjs.summary: Groups the indexed source into fifteen canonical guide/reference notes instead of producing one file per symbol. It combines package versions and workspace settings, moves old links to their owning sections, backs up managed originals outside the vault, and archives granular notes only after validation. Unmanaged inbound links and locally edited canonical files stop pruning for review.

scripts/graph-community-context.mjs.summary: Builds meaningful context for graph communities without changing their members or edges. Stable source/symbol anchors and file rules supply names, purposes, questions, and entry points; reviewed maps supply symbol explanations. Cross-group relationships are counted from indexed edges, and investigation tours are explicitly reading routes rather than asserted call chains.

scripts/enrich-graph.mjs.summary: Applies community context to the local graph, writes native Graphify labels and a readable community guide, regenerates the stock HTML, and adds the contextual browser adapter. It validates the expected exporter hooks before injecting safely serialized data. Numeric memberships and recorded edges remain unchanged.

scripts/graph-context-ui.js.summary: Adds the interactive context sidebar to the generated graph viewer. Application/all-group controls, investigation tours, community questions, source responsibilities, Obsidian links, and selected-symbol explanations complement the native graph. The browser adapter is local viewer behavior and does not alter the tourism app or database.

scripts/knowledge-context.mjs.summary: Loads and resolves the reviewed explanation maps shared by Graphify and Obsidian. File-summary and shared-description references keep prose in one place, while consumers receive the same string-based context shape. Duplicate keys, malformed references and missing targets fail explicitly.

symbols.scripts/generate-third-party-notices.mjs: Locates an installed package by searching node_modules upward from its parent, records its license notices once per name/version, and recursively visits its runtime dependencies. Missing packages or license notice files cause the prebuild to fail.

external.frontend_src_index: Graph resolution placeholder for the ./index.css import in Frontend/src/main.tsx. The source file Frontend/src/index.css is the browser stylesheet; the graph’s source-less identifier is a parser/resolution limitation, not a JavaScript function or configured path alias.
external.ref_node_url: Node.js URL built-in. fileURLToPath converts module-relative file URLs into filesystem paths in Vite configuration, tests, and scripts.
external.ref_node_path: Node.js path built-in. dirname and join support installed-package lookup and generated-file paths in the notice script; export tooling also uses path helpers.
external.ref_node_assert: Node.js assertion built-in, imported as node:assert/strict in tests and seed validation. Its equality and rejection checks verify behavior; it is not application business logic.
external.ref_node_crypto: Node.js cryptography built-in. Backend source uses password/session cryptography and identifiers, while test probes use randomUUID; the graph placeholder groups these distinct imports.
external.ref_node_events: Node.js events built-in. Backend HTTP tests use once to await a server event before making requests.
external.ref_node_fs: Node.js filesystem built-ins, including node:fs/promises. Scripts read migrations, seed data and package licenses; the Vite isolation test creates and removes a temporary harmless probe.
external.ref_node_net: Node.js networking built-in. Backend tests import AddressInfo only as a TypeScript type to inspect an ephemeral HTTP server’s bound port.
external.ref_node_test: Node.js built-in test runner. Tests import test and, where needed, afterEach to register checks and cleanup hooks.
external.ref_node_child_process: Node.js child_process built-in. The Obsidian export wrapper uses spawnSync to run the installed Graphify CLI and checks its exit status before enriching the exported notes.
external.ref_typescript: Unresolved graph reference to the locally installed TypeScript compiler API imported by the note-context exporter. The module parses source declarations and JSON/JSONC for documentation details; that parsing does not replace running the project typecheck command.
